# visualization.event_plot.plot_design_matrix { #fmrimod.visualization.event_plot.plot_design_matrix }

```python
plot_design_matrix(
    model,
    term_name=None,
    figsize=None,
    separate_regressors=True,
    style=None,
    show_events=True,
    block_x='global',
```

Alias of `plot_event_model` kept for the former API.

``separate_regressors=False`` selects the overlay style.
